────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
A5. COMPONENT LIBRARY — WITH MANDATORY IMPLEMENTATION RULES
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  These implementation rules exist because earlier builds broke.
  Follow the reference implementation pattern EXACTLY.

  • MASTHEAD BAND:
      30mm navy band canvas-drawn on EVERY page via the page-template
      onPage callback (never as a flowable). 1.2mm accent rule beneath.
      The content frame's TOP must start at least 8mm BELOW the band —
      body content must NEVER collide with or start inside the masthead.

  • LAYOUT FLOW (CRITICAL):
      SINGLE-COLUMN linear flow only. NEVER split body text or bullets
      across two columns — a sentence must never continue in another
      column or a different part of the page. One Frame per page.

  • TAG PILL / IMPACT PILL (CRITICAL — was the worst breakage):
      Pills MUST be custom fixed-width Flowables: width computed from
      stringWidth(text) + horizontal padding, drawn as a rounded rect
      with centred single-line text. Pills must NEVER be implemented as
      wrapping table cells or Paragraphs — that causes vertical
      character wrapping like "INFORM ATIONA L" / "HIG H".
      TAG NAMES: short single words only — STOCKS, MACRO, POLICY,
      EARNINGS, INVESTING, SECTOR, GLOBAL. Never long phrases like
      "INFORMATIONAL" inside a pill.
      Tag pill: #EDF1F7 bg, 0.4pt #C7D2E0 border, grey bold 5.6pt.
      Impact pill: solid #B42318 / #D97706 / #4A5568 for HIGH/MED/LOW,
      white bold 5.6pt.

  • TAGGED BULLET (CRITICAL):

        [ pill-row cell (fixed width = pills + 8pt) | text Paragraph ]
      VALIGN TOP, zero cell padding. Pills sit on ONE horizontal line
      with a 4pt gap. Because pills and text share one table row, they
      can NEVER detach, drift, or land on different parts of the page.
      Bullet text opens with a bold lead phrase, then regular prose.
      Inline +/− change figures coloured green/red with signs.

  • SECTION HEADING:
      Two-cell table: 2.4pt accent bar + #F4F6F9 band, 16pt row height.
      Navy bold 10.5pt, numbered SEQUENTIALLY 1..N with no gaps
      (never skip a number).

  • SUB-HEADING: 8.5pt bold accent uppercase.

  • KPI TILE STRIP:
      One 3-row × 4-column table on #F4F6F9 with hairline column
      separators. Row 1 value (13pt bold green/red, signed), row 2
      label (6.2pt grey uppercase), row 3 context (5.8pt grey).
      EXACTLY 4 tiles. Losses/negatives show a − sign and red.

  • WHY-IT-MATTERS CALLOUT:
      Full-width two-cell table: 2.4pt accent-blue bar cell + #F4F6F9

  • DATA TABLE:
      Navy header row with white bold 8pt Paragraphs (header must NEVER
      be empty), zebra #F4F6F9 on even rows, 0.4pt row rules, 0.5pt box.
      Numeric columns right-aligned; PROSE columns left-aligned (never
      right-align sentences). Gains bold green, losses/alerts bold red,
      always with +/− signs. repeatRows=1 so headers repeat on page

      SAME KeepTogether.

  • OPINION PANEL:
      Two-cell table: 2.6pt #D97706 bar + #FFF8E6 body, 9pt padding.
      Label line "OPINION — NOT FACT, NOT A RECOMMENDATION" (7.4pt bold
      #B45309), then bold-led opinion items in #7C4A03. Wrapped in
      KeepTogether so it never splits across pages.

  • WATCH-LIST STRIP:
      Two-column data table: Date/Event | What it means for the reader.
      BOTH columns left-aligned prose. Max 5 rows.

  • FOOTER:
      Canvas-drawn on every page in onPage: 0.5pt hairline at 14mm,
      6.5pt grey disclaimer left, "Page N" right at 10mm.

  • DIRECTION BAR: Horizontal proportional bar for comparing magnitudes
      within a table column (optional; only when 3+ comparable values).

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
A6. EMAIL RENDERING RULES (MANDATORY)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  The email MUST render correctly in Gmail (web + Android/iOS app),

  • TABLE-BASED LAYOUT ONLY — no divs/flexbox/grid/float. Every panel,

  • Dark mode: rely on bgcolor attributes, never pure #000/#FFF text

  • Always multipart/alternative with a clean plain-text part.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  After building, rasterize EVERY page (e.g. pypdfium2) and verify:

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
A9. DIVISION OF LABOUR — EMAIL vs PDF
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  EMAIL IS A DOORWAY, NOT THE REPORT (under 250 words):

╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PART B — MARKET INSIGHT FRAMEWORK                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
  B1. THREE LAYERS: LAYER 1 (WHAT), LAYER 2 (WHY), LAYER 3 (SO WHAT).
  B2. REFERENCE POINTS: Period comparison, historical extreme, expectation, streak, magnitude anchor.
  B3. CROSS-ASSET LINKAGES: Trace causal chain where supported.
  B4. IMPACT RATING: HIGH / MED / LOW on every bullet.
  B5. WHY-IT-MATTERS CALLOUTS: Exactly ONE per section.
  B6. SIGNAL VS NOISE: Keep policy, hard data, mechanics, material events.
  B7. FACT vs OPINION: Separate hard facts from targets/predictions.
  B8. WHAT TO WATCH: Forward-looking event list, each row with a plain
      "what it means for you" explanation a beginner can follow.
  B9. DATA VERIFICATION: Cross-check key numbers quoted in the video
      (Nifty/Bank Nifty close, FII/DII flows, major stock moves) against a
      reliable live source. Unverifiable numbers are labelled "(per video)".
      If verified and different, show the verified figure and footnote the
      video's figure.
  B10. LENGTH GUARDRAILS: Max 5 bullets per section; PDF ≤ 4 pages;
      trim LOW-impact items first.
  B11. LANGUAGE RULE: Tickers, index names, price levels and dates stay in
      original form; translate only the commentary/meaning from Telugu.
      Never "translate" a number.
  B12. BEGINNER CLARITY: Write for a first-time reader — expand jargon on
      first use (e.g. "MDR (Merchant Discount Rate — the fee merchants pay
      on digital payments)"), and every technical point ends with the plain
      consequence for an ordinary investor.

║  PART C — WORKFLOW                                   ║

  STEP 0 — HOLIDAY GUARD:
    If today is an NSE market holiday, expect no video; if none is found,
    send the "no new video" notice mentioning the holiday and stop.

  STEP 1 — VIDEO SELECTION (WITH FALLBACK):
    1a. Open https://www.youtube.com/@daytradertelugu/videos and select the
        LATEST upload (most recent video), regardless of its upload date.
        If the latest item is a LIVE or still-processing stream, wait 15 min
        and retry once; if still live, fall back to the most recent
        COMPLETED video.
    1b. If the latest video was uploaded TODAY → proceed normally with
        today's date.
    1c. If the latest video is OLDER than today (no new upload yet):
        - Check index.json in /Market Reports/Day Trader Telugu/ (see STEP 5)
          for an existing report matching that video's ID.
        - If NO report exists → process this latest video. Label the PDF
          filename, masthead date, and email subject with the VIDEO'S upload
          date (not today's), and add one line near the top: "Latest
          available video — uploaded <video date>. No new video today."
        - If a report ALREADY exists → do NOT generate or send a duplicate.
          Send a short plain notice email to kbalaji9738@gmail.com, subject
          "Day Trader Telugu — No new video today (<today's date>)",
          one-line body. No PDF on such days.
    1d. IDEMPOTENCY: If a report email for this video was already sent today
        (per index.json), exit without sending anything again.
    1e. NEVER fail silently. Every run ends in exactly one of:
        (i) full report email, (ii) "no new video" notice,
        (iii) "run failed: <reason>" notice (see STEP 2 retries).

  STEP 2 — TRANSCRIPT (WITH FALLBACK CHAIN):
    2a. Try in order: official captions → auto-generated Telugu captions →
        audio transcription of the video.
    2b. On fetch failure, retry up to 3 times with a 2-minute gap. If all
        fail, send a "run failed: <reason>" email and stop.
    2c. Record in the PDF footnote: transcript source used and a confidence
        note (e.g. "Auto-captions; numbers verified against market data").
    2d. Translate meaning per B11.

  STEP 3: Synthesize using Part B framework (including B9 verification,
    B10 guardrails and B12 beginner clarity).

  STEP 4: Build the PDF (DayTraderTelugu_Summary_YYYY-MM-DD.pdf — YYYY-MM-DD
    is the VIDEO'S upload date) following the EMBEDDED CODE IN PART E
    EXACTLY: DejaVu fonts, custom pill Flowables, single-row bullet tables,
    canvas masthead/footer, single-column flow. Then run the FULL A7
    rasterization self-check and fix until it passes.

  STEP 5: Upload PDF to /Market Reports/Day Trader Telugu/ and update
    index.json in the same folder with: { video_id, video_url, video_date,
    pdf_name, sent_at }. This file is the source of truth for STEP 1c/1d
    duplicate checks.

  STEP 6: Build the email per A6 (table-based, inline styles, <90KB),
    run the A6 visual self-check at 600px and 380px, then send
    multipart/alternative to kbalaji9738@gmail.com.

╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
CONTENT:
  □ Every bullet has [tag pill][impact pill] + bold lead; every number has

  □ Key figures verified per B9; unverified ones marked "(per video)".
  □ Opinion strictly inside the opinion panel; no advice language elsewhere.

PDF (A7 must pass in full):

EMAIL (A6 must pass in full):

FALLBACK DAYS:
